intro: Every report you may read, from sales to stock to people, in one place. Find one, run it for the period you want, export it, and have it sent to people on a schedule.
start: Find a report by its area of the business or its kind, or search for it by name.
Star the reports you use most. They wait at the top under Your reports and show on your dashboard.
Save your filters as a view, so the report opens the way you like it.
Schedule the reports others need, so they arrive by email without anyone asking.
